response_firewall_incident.cause: The Figshare demographic text uses carriage-return record separators without newline bytes. The Gate 0 code used binary readline(), which stops only at newline, so the intended first-record read consumed the entire response-bearing file into the logged/artifact field header_line_only.
response_firewall_incident.values_exposed: population-size table contents were unintentionally materialized in the CI log/artifact
response_firewall_incident.consequence: Peck Ranch can no longer serve as a fresh independent validation of the post-Glanville Layer-B predictor in this development sequence. Do not use the leaked values to tune worlds, features, thresholds, holdout, or decision rules.

dryad_main_workbook.interpretation: The primary survey workbook needed to audit surveyed-zero versus unsurveyed/missing semantics could not be reproducibly frozen through the one-shot public route.

stop_reason: The candidate is independently invalidated by accidental response exposure, and the primary survey workbook also remains transport-blocked. No demographic model, world tuning, structural Gate 1, or Layer-B heldout prediction is allowed on this candidate as a fresh independent test.
next_method_action: Fix the generic response-firewall first-record reader so it is bounded by either CR or LF at the byte level and regression-test CR-only, LF-only, and CRLF files before screening another response-bearing candidate.
